spans.s: दध [dadha], a. Holding, possessing, giving &c. -n. share, portion; दधशब्दो भागधेयवचनः । त्रद्यथा कण्टकाय दधं नापिताय दधमिति । देवदधानि देवभागा इत्यर्थः । ŚB. on
Coagulated milk, thick sour milk; क्षीरं दधिभावेन परिणमते Ś.B; दध्योदनः &c.
A garment. -Comp. -अन्नम्, -ओदनम् boiled rice mixed with दधि;
. -उत्तरम्, उत्तर- क(ग)म् the skim of curdled milk, whey. -उदः, -उदकः the ocean of coagulated milk. -कुल्या a stream of दधि;
. -कूर्चिका mixture of boiled and coagulated milk. -क्रा, -क्रावन् N. of a divine horse (personification of the morning sun); दधिक्रामग्निमुषसं च देवीम्
. Kāśi. -चारः a churning-stick. -जम् fresh butter. -धेनुः f. a cow represented by दधि (offered to priests); Bhāva.

168. -फलः the wood-apple (कपित्थ). -मण़्डः, -वारिः n. whey. -मन्थनम् churning coagulated milk. -शोणः a monkey. -सक्तु m. (pl.) barley-meal mixed with coagulated milk. -सारः, -स्नेहः fresh butter. -स्वेदः buttermilk.
दधिस्यति [dadhisyati], Den. P. To wish for curds; also दध्यस्यति.

दधीचः [dadhīcḥ] चिः [ciḥ] दध्यच् [dadhyac], चिः दध्यच् N. of a celebrated sage, who became ready to die, and offered his bones to the gods; with these bones the architect of the gods made a thunderbolt with which Indra defeated Vṛitra and other demons. -Comp. -अस्थि n.
दधृष् [dadhṛṣ], a. Impudent, bold; सुग्रीवो निनदन् दधृक्
Made of or from, or mixed or sprinkled with, coagulated milk.
Carrying about or selling coagulated milk.
Eating anything with coagulated milk. -कम् A kind or broth.
